kind: ephemeral original fence-acquisition reconciliation port; no persisted authority schema

observations.acquired_capture: Actual Active original fence and membership revision, whole-unit write/membership/timer/external-work/drained evidence, exclusive original-request attribution.
observations.acquired_restore: Actual Active original fence/membership/external-obligation revisions, whole-selection rewind-independent/replay-safe custody, exclusive original-request attribution. Controlled start requires its separate fresh safety contract.
observations.actual: Authenticated actual context/full inventory, nonempty unique canonical original selected unit, exact request/attempt association and opaque evidence binding all fields.
observations.not_acquired: Qualified exact nonapplication excluding transient acquisition/release; current absence/inactivity alone is insufficient.
observations.unresolved: Qualified settled observation cannot resolve acquisition; not a lost reply or provider failure.

recovery: No new persistence schema/counter, automatic receipt, default provider or authenticated backend. Existing journals/obligations remain the owners.
Observation reservation has consumed original allowance before provider invocation. Reconstructing a request grants no repeat-dispatch permission.
Unavailable, Unsupported and Indeterminate retain the exact pending observation and mutation; never record Uncertain from a lost reply.
Only a separately qualified actual integration may submit the exact observed receipt to the existing guarded journal owner.
Pending, Applied, NotApplied and Uncertain retain original obligations and source references; no refund, acquisition retry, capture/load/start or terminal/fence/reference release.

Terminal replay is local and invokes no provider. Fresh live evidence is separate. Actual single-call accounting, authority, attribution, custody and exclusive chronology require integration qualification.

request.digest: NUL-terminated ASCII ic-backup/fence-reconciliation/v1 domain; 64 lowercase ASCII obligation hash; 64 lowercase ASCII original authority hash; big-endian u32 mutation attempt; 64 lowercase ASCII challenge hash.
request.intent: Exact original whole-unit obligation, full-plan derived acquisition authority including budgets, pending mutation and fresh caller-owned challenge.
request.reservation: Derive intent digest before reserving; bind request only after exact pending observation reservation. Recheck original current journal before admitting result.
request.result_association: Exact request hash and both original mutation/allocated observation IDs. Observation ID is allocated after intent hashing; independent result association rejects cross-attempt replay.
